svg.title: k moves the null time, not the voltage
svg.desc: svpwm_clamp at |v| = Vbus/2. As k moves between the bottom clamp, midclamp and the top clamp, all three phase duties move together and the line-to-line voltages stay the same. Only the split of the null time between O000, all low, and O111, all high, changes. Reading 3 phases, a low-side current sense has O000 to read in, so the window at the line-to-line peak is 6.70 us at k = 0, 3.35 us at k = 1/2 and none at k = 1.
svg.text: k moves the null time, not the voltage
svpwm_clamp(vA, vB, vC, k) · |v| = Vbus/2 · 20 kHz · 3 phases read
O000 · all low: the low-side window
k · the share of the null time at O111
dutyA − dutyC = vA − vC, for every k
